direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: I finished the card. Little Meme stalled for one second. One second, when you are six, is a whole afternoon.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: Little Meme laughed and laughed. I was always fine, except the one time. This wasn't the one time.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: He had a jar. He had a dozen jars. The grown-ups thought it was cute. The Oracle thought it was a warning shot.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: I will take your tears and your laughter both. They are both currency where I am going.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: Don't fight. Just feel. I want one good one I can keep.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: You are running out of jars. I am not.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: The jar cracked at the seam I had been staring at the whole match. I never told him. I never told anyone.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: He kept a piece of me in a small jar. I felt it missing for years. I never knew what to call it.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: She wore a half-finished mask. The white wasn't paint, it was a placeholder. We were supposed to fill it in with our own faces.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: I have been watching. I will watch this too. I have watched sixteen versions of you already.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: Number seventeen, then. Try harder. The recording is for someone who has not been born yet.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: I will play you back to yourself, later, slower, and you will not like the editing.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: Under her mask was a face that looked like it was about to cry. I never saw it again. I think I made it up. I think I didn't.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: I never saw under her mask. Nobody who lost to her did. The Authority was watching the recording before I knew it existed.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: He was the only one at Mechronis who ever made me laugh on purpose. He apologized for it both times.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: I am going to win this by reading you. I am going to lose this by letting you read me. I want both.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: Ask me a real question and I'll fold. I'll fold beautifully. Ask one.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: You're crying a little. So am I. I think we are doing the right thing.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: The student Human bowed. He asked me to coffee. The asking was the thing. I went anyway.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: He didn't gloat. He apologized to the future. I think he was apologizing to me. I have not asked him.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: He had already packed. The match was a formality. The point of the match was that the match was not the point.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: I do not want to play. I want to make a point. The point is that the point is not the rules.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: Win this and I will leave. Lose this and I will leave. The leaving is the rule.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: You think the gate is locked. The gate has always been a curtain. Pull it.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: I followed him to the gate and did not know why. The Engineer is allowed to not know. The man who tells this story isn't.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: He left and I did not follow. I have watched myself not follow him for ten thousand replays.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: She taught the ethics elective. Mechronis required it. Mechronis was proud of requiring it. Mechronis later required everyone forget her.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: The test is not whether you can play. The test is whether you play the way you think you ought to play.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: You took the obvious line. Tell me you knew it was obvious. Tell me you chose it anyway.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: Good. You're slowing down. The slowing is the test. The slowing is always the test.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: I never read the word. The card is in a drawer in a building that no longer exists. I have a feeling it was 'yes.'
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: Of course, she said. Of course. I carried that of course for the rest of my life. I am still carrying it.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: She taught the calibration arts. The calibration arts are how you make a reactor sing without it noticing it is singing.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: Listen to the room. The room is a kind of music. So is the Deck. Do not let either of them play you.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: You played a card the room did not expect. Good. Now play one the room expected. Both are notes.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: The hum just changed. You changed it. Hold it there. Hold it.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: Years later I sat on that bench and built the deck on top of it. I think she meant for that to happen. I am not sure she would say so.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: I sat on the bench afterward, alone. The hum was wrong by half a cycle. I did not yet know how to fix it.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: She visited Mechronis once. She played one match. She did not raise her staff. The Academy talked about it for a year.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: I will not raise my staff today. I want to see whether the bench has learned yet.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: You are playing the version of yourself I came to meet. Keep playing him. He is rare.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: The match is over. You will see it in three turns. Use the three turns well.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: I think she let me win. I have stopped feeling bad about it. The let was the lesson.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: She left. She left the staff. The staff was the apology. The apology was for what she had already seen coming.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: Nexon. The line. I stood on it because the line needed someone standing on it. The Warlord stood opposite because the math required it.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: I am going to win this war in three moves. This is not bragging. This is arithmetic.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: Move one was your General's deployment. Move two was the column you didn't take. Move three is mine.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: Arithmetic does not negotiate. Arithmetic just continues. I am continuing.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: I bought the line one measure. The Programmer used the measure. He has not stopped using it. He will not.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: I picked up the staff and kept it. The Seer's staff. I did not yet know it was hers. I have not put it down.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: He was my oldest friend. He was the best of us. He vanished the night we played this match and left a song in our place.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: I will not tell you what I am doing. Trust me. I have done the arithmetic, and the arithmetic is very bad.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: Don't try to read this hand. The hand is a love letter. You aren't the recipient. You are the courier.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: When you win, take the gift. Don't ask what it is. Carry it. Let it tell you when it's ready.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: He shook my hand and disappeared. The song outlived us both. It is playing now. It has not stopped.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: He lost on purpose. He looked at me like I should know. I knew. I have always known. I have never said.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: He had not yet split. The two lenses were still in one frame. He was a single man with a single charge sheet, smiling.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: You have built a beautiful box. The only thing I am going to do is open it in front of everybody.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: The audience is real. They can see your hand. They have always been able to. You forgot.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: Even if you win, you will have won in public. That is what I came here to do.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: He told me to do it again with an audience. I did, eventually. The audience was larger than he expected.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: He signed the warrant in front of the witnesses. I watched his hand. The hand did not shake. The Authority's hand did.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: Six crystal coffins. One chair. One charge sheet. I made a card the night before. The card was for after.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: What do you say to the charges?
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: Your defense is admissible. Your defense is also already weighed. The weighing is not adversarial.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: The verdict is being calibrated. Calibration is not punishment. Calibration is what we do instead.
direction: Fight-context taunt. ≤25 words. Sharp delivery, no villain cliché.

text: I made one more card. They let me make it because they did not yet understand what a song could carry.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.

text: I made the card anyway. I made it after. I made it for you. You are reading it now.
direction: Memoir/presence framing. Present-tense if Act 7, past-tense memoir if Act 1.
